newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli helicopters strike in eastern Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli helicopters strike in eastern Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli helicopters fired rockets on Saturday into suspected Hizbollah targets in the Syrian-policed eastern Bekaa valley, security souces said.
They said two helicopters fired four rockets into the village of Libbaya in the western side of the eastern Bekaa valley.
There was no immediate report of casualties in the air attack.
The pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas fight Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from a 15-km-wide (nine miles) south Lebanon occupation zone.
